segments.text: Airship puts a design canvas in front of the dev server you're already running as a reverse proxy. So nothing enters your project, your bundle, or your
dependencies. Click an element, describe the change, and your existing coding agent edits the real source using the credentials it already has. Every frame is a live browser window.
